<Callout type="info">
  `GoogleGenerativeAIAdapter` has no direct v2 replacement. For v2, see [Runtime server adapter](/runtime-server-adapter).
</Callout>

Copilot Runtime adapter for Google Generative AI (e.g. Gemini).

## Example

The adapter reads `GOOGLE_API_KEY` unless you pass `apiKey`.

```ts
import {
  CopilotRuntime,
  GoogleGenerativeAIAdapter,
  copilotRuntimeNextJSAppRouterEndpoint,
} from "@copilotkit/runtime";

const copilotKit = new CopilotRuntime();

const serviceAdapter = new GoogleGenerativeAIAdapter({
  model: "gemini-3.5-flash",
  apiVersion: "v1",
});

export const POST = copilotRuntimeNextJSAppRouterEndpoint({
  runtime: copilotKit,
  serviceAdapter,
  endpoint: "/api/copilotkit",
}).handleRequest;
```

## Constructor Parameters

<PropertyReference name="model" type="string"  > 
A custom Google Generative AI model to use.
</PropertyReference>

<PropertyReference name="apiVersion" type="'v1' | 'v1beta'"  > 
The API version to use (e.g. "v1" or "v1beta"). Defaults to "v1".
</PropertyReference>

<PropertyReference name="apiKey" type="string"  > 
The API key to use.
</PropertyReference>
